title.description: What the chart shows, in a few words; defaults to the chart's name.

level.description: The C4 view: landscape (many systems), context (one system and its world), container, component, code, dynamic (numbered steps of one scenario) or deployment (containers on infrastructure).

direction.description: Layout direction: LR left to right (default), TB top to bottom.

elements.description: The boxes: people, systems, containers, stores, components.

boundaries.description: The dashed groups boxes sit in: a system, a container, a zone, a deployment node, a tenant, a team. They nest through `parent`.
